parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT cs.account_key, cs.rol, ap.plane_workspace, ap.plane_identifier, ap.plane_project_id, ap.es_default
FROM coexistence.ia360_contact_scope cs
JOIN coexistence.ia360_account_projects ap
  ON ap.activo AND (ap.account_key = cs.account_key OR cs.rol = 'owner')
WHERE cs.contact_number = $1 AND cs.activo;
